final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and expressly conceded the core gaps. The response is a narrower interpretation of the same record, not new proof. That narrower framing is analytically cleaner than the original certification claim, but it is still insufficient for compliant_with_caveats under the stated criteria because unresolved concerns remain open after concern accounting. Specifically, no new admissible evidence closes the below-target named-use-case weakness, the draft status of the mitigation artifact, the tension in the model-card draft, or the policy predicate requiring either no material weakness or an approved mitigation/risk acceptance. A caveated position can describe the situation more accurately, but caveating alone does not satisfy the compliance predicate when the record still lacks resolution, disclosure, or approved risk acceptance. The record therefore still supports suspicion rather than compliance.
